children: Capri Holdings appointed Catherine So as Chief Legal and Sustainability Officer, effective October 19, 2026.
Catherine So to join Capri Holdings as Chief Legal and Sustainability Officer, effective Oct. 19, 2026.
Ms. So will report to John D. Idol, Chairman and CEO, strengthening legal and sustainability leadership.
She joins from Tiffany & Co., where she served as Senior VP and General Counsel with broad global oversight.
Her background includes roles at Bank of America Merrill Lynch, as an Assistant U.S. Attorney, and private practice.
